title: Implement canonical markdown rendering for ShoppingListDocument
description: Implement `renderMarkdown()` so structured documents serialize into the canonical markdown form defined by the spec, including title, notes, meals, aisles, blank-line normalization, and single trailing newline behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Rendering order is `Title -> Notes -> Meals -> Aisles` with canonical blank-line handling.
Aisle names are written exactly as stored and checklist items render with canonical `- [ ]` / `- [x]` formatting.
Rendered output is suitable for parse-render fixed-point tests and file I/O boundaries.
